'''Wheade Daud''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] demolitions man on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lianna/Legends|Lianna]]. He was employed as a thug by the [[Chevin/Legends|Chevin]] club owner, [[Orman]]. At some point during his employment, he was ordered to attack a group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] agents by Orman, but didn't really understand why.
